messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sat 15 Feb
messages.plaintextBody: The DMS will be unavailable for scheduled maintenance on Saturday 15 February between 07:00 and 11:00. Please check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and the data room are unaffected. — IT Helpdesk
